regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing, non-directional rotation: AI Infrastructure leads with a modest score edge over Cybersecurity, but breadth of eligible themes is only 39% and 'one_narrative' is false, so this is a multi-theme dispersion regime, not a single runaway leader. The absolute-trend gate is helping (gate_helps: true), so trend discipline is doing its one validated job — drawdown/shake-out control — while cross-sectional momentum is explicitly display-only. Track record is a moderate sample (n=89) with a poor directional accuracy (0.483), so call conviction should stay low across the board.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Cybersecurity (rank 2, score 1.627) can hold leadership or hand off back to AI Infrastructure (rank 1, score 1.975) whose val_state is 'fading'. A confirmed handoff would show Cybersecurity's daily score closing above AI Infrastructure's for five consecutive sessions while breadth stays above 0.9 — that would retire this watch; if instead AI Infrastructure's breadth (0.708) climbs back above 0.8 and its score re-widens the margin, the cyber challenge fades.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the highest-durability eligible theme that is still trending: it ranks 2nd on momentum with the strongest breadth (1.0) and a full durability_bar (0.85) behind a trend hurst_tag. It is the only crowded theme among the leaders, but crowding here is a size-down caution only, not a fade — and the absolute-trend gate is helping in this market, so staying with a durable, broad, trending theme is the most defensible lean for drawdown control.
evidence: gate_helps: true (trend discipline validated for drawdown control in this market)
theses.dissent: Cybersecurity is the most crowded theme in the top ranks (crowding_z 1.8) and the leader AI Infrastructure is not crowded, so Cybersecurity's extended positioning could make it the first to shake out if the narrowing rotation continues or the AI-Infra narrative reasserts dominance.

falsifier.text: CIBR lags SMH by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Technology (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Equal-weight Technology is a lower-conviction structural lean: it is eligible, trending (hurst_tag 'trend'), with a high durability_bar (0.82) and solid breadth (0.689), but only mid-pack momentum (rank 7). The equal-weight construction avoids the Magnificent-Seven concentration that makes cap-weighted tech a single-factor bet, and the absolute-trend gate supports staying with trending themes for shake-out control.
theses.dissent: Equal-weight tech still carries the same AI/hardware beta as the leaders but without the momentum tailwind — if the AI narrative rolls over, equal-weight tech falls with it while lagging the concentrated leaders on the way up.

falsifier.text: XLK lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Robotics & Automation
theses.thesis: Robotics & Automation is eligible but carries a mean-revert hurst_tag, which is the regime the absolute-trend gate is designed to screen against. It has a mid durability_bar (0.56) and unremarkable breadth (0.583), and with momentum essentially flat (rank 15, score 0.465) there is no trend leg to ride. In a market where the one validated edge is trend-gate drawdown control, a mean-reverting theme is a poor candidate.
evidence: gate_helps: true (trend discipline is the validated edge, and this theme fails it)
theses.dissent: Robotics has a mild negative crowding_z (-0.06), meaning it is not stretched, and mean-revert can occasionally produce sharp counter-trend rallies if an industrial-automation catalyst hits — avoiding it could miss a quick tactical bounce.

falsifier.text: BOTZ closes above its 60-day high on rising volume before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
